messages:
rana (docs): heads-up: i'm submitting a small but careful docs PR to replace the callback-style streaming examples with iterator-based snippets for py/ts/go. includes a short migration checklist + an archival plan for legacy callbacks. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5234
sam (eng-runtime): good move. please document resume-token TTL (we currently issue tokens with ~30s best-effort reuse window) and a short table of client actions for token states (present/expired/missing).
devon (eng-ml): also add a compatibility note about model quantization swaps. we had one customer see truncated final tokens after reconnecting to a quantized variant. a one-paragraph caveat is enough.
rana (docs): will do. proposed examples:
- py async iterator + retry wrapper showing exponential backoff and abort after N attempts
- ts for-await-of with AbortController and explicit resume_token reattach param
- go channel-reader with context.WithTimeout + example of idempotent resume behavior
peggy (eng-platform): FYI snippet-harness failed on a go example earlier due to missing timeout; snippet CI: https://ci.internal/snippets/8812 (context deadline exceeded). we should ensure examples include timeouts so tests are stable.
bot-ci: snippet-harness: failed job `docs-examples` - examples/go/stream-reconnect-example.go line 20 (context deadline exceeded). logs: https://ci.internal/snippets/8812/logs
sam (eng-runtime): TS example should also show a tiny backoff demo (maxRetries + jitter) so folks don't retry too aggressively. small code suggestion in PR comments.
rana (docs): adding both jitter and a small code comment about token accounting (long-lived streams still accumulate token usage while open).
devon (eng-ml): for the migration doc, include a short callback->iterator mapping table:
- on_chunk -> yield chunk
- on_error -> thrown exception
- on_done -> iterator end
also add a brief test plan: unit mock for resume path + snippet-harness e2e. i'll add the mock.
peggy (eng-platform): lint reminder: filenames must be kebab-case and snippets should set environment variables in examples to `REDWOOD_API_KEY` rather than hardcoding keys. i added a CI note.
archiver-bot: Note: legacy callbacks archived to /legacy/callbacks.md in the PR branch. A deprecation banner will be auto-inserted on merge.
rana (docs): pushed changes: resume-token TTL table, migration mapping, jittered backoff samples, go timeout, filenames kebabified, env var guidance. kicked the harness.
bot-ci: snippet-harness: all checks passed on branch docs/streaming-iterator-migration.
sam (eng-runtime): left two tiny inline suggestions about KV-cache wording and resume token language (best-effort; don't guarantee exact prefix restoration).
devon (eng-ml): added the unit mock for resume reconnect and a short note about quantization risk.
peggy (eng-platform): lgtm. please tag release-notes with `docs: streaming iterator migration` when landing.
rana (docs): will tag. merging in 10m if no objections. thanks everyone! :tada:
